questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical policy-as-code skills in Terraform Cloud, including workspace associations, policy scoping, and PR-time validation workflows.

## Key Concepts
- Policy as code with Sentinel
- Per-environment workspaces and policy inheritance
- Tagging standards and region whitelisting
- PR validation and failure workflows

## Code Example
```javascript
// Sentinel policy example (illustrative)
import "tfplan/v2" as plan

allowed_regions = ["us-east-1","us-west-2"]

main = rule {
  all plan.resource_changes as rc {
    rc.change.after.tags["Environment"] is not null &&
    rc.change.after.tags["Owner"] is not null &&
    rc.change.after.region in allowed_regions
  }
}
```

## Testing Steps
1. Create test configurations with valid and invalid tags/regions
2. Submit PRs to trigger Sentinel policy evaluation
3. Verify policies pass for compliant configurations
4. Confirm policies fail and block merges for violations
5. Test policy inheritance across all workspace environments

## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to design safe blue/green deployment patterns using Terraform with a private provider, focusing on idempotent upgrades and drift control.

## Key Concepts
- Blue/Green deployment pattern
- for_each across color variants
- Central traffic_split map controlling user traffic
- Lifecycle prevent_destroy to protect active components
- Drift detection with plan-based validation across environments

## Code Example
```hcl
variable "traffic_split" {
  type    = map(number)
  default = { blue = 100, green = 0 }
}

variable "gateway_colors" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = ["blue", "green"]
}

module "gateway" {
  source   = "./gateway"
  for_each = toset(var.gateway_colors)
  
  color       = each.key
  environment = var.environment
  
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "api_gateway_routing" "traffic" {
  for_each = var.traffic_split
  
  color       = each.key
  percentage  = each.value
  gateway_id  = module.gateway[each.key].id
}
```

## Promotion Commands
```bash
# 1. Plan and validate drift
terraform plan -var='traffic_split={blue=0,green=100}' -out=green-promotion.tfplan

# 2. Apply atomic switch
terraform apply green-promotion.tfplan

# 3. Verify traffic distribution
terraform show | grep traffic_split
```
